header: THE ERROR LOG, IN THE DATABASE (22 Nov 2026). On the production host (Vercel) the disk is not kept between requests, so a log FILE cannot exist there: I made the log a table, grouped so that it cannot grow without end: one row per DISTINCT error (its fingerprint, see scrub.ts), with how many times it happened and when it first and last did. A thousand people hitting the same bug is one row with a count of a thousand. Rows are limited per source (browser and server separately, so a flood of fake browser reports can never push real server errors out), resolved ones are dropped after 30 days and everything after 90; when rows are dropped I am told (digest.ts). The table is closed to the browser (row level security, nothing granted to anon or authenticated). It is created on first use when the database login may, or by src/lib/nl2sql/sql/31_app_error_log.sql.
